page: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_v3 is a memory-optimized server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, featuring 44 physical cores and 88 dedicated vCPUs running at 4.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding 17.45 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided via a 410 GB disk, and the instance is premium storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong to top-tier performance across multiple domains. The system achieves top-tier status in Geekbench single-core and multi-core metrics, as well as Passmark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth is a notable strength, with large block read-only speeds reaching 419.99 GB/sec and write speeds at 186.04 GB/sec, both placing in the top tier. Database operations on Passmark score 34867.58, also in the top tier, while Redis SET operations reach 109.3 million operations per second.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers high memory capacity relative to compute cores, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of multi-node clustering. However, single-core stress-ng performance and Passmark memory scores register as average, indicating that workloads relying heavily on single-threaded execution or specific memory latency profiles may not experience the same top-tier scaling as multi-threaded operations.

This server is designed for memory-intensive and database-heavy workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers, software compilation, static web serving, and medium-scale language model inference, where the 1.5 TB memory capacity and high multi-threaded performance can be fully utilized.
